about: VerseUp is built on the work of many people. These are the texts, study tools, fonts and software in the app, with the credit each one asks for. Tap any of them to see more.

resources.name: King James Version
resources.author: Translated 1611; Blayney standard text 1769. Electronic edition by eBible.org
resources.description: The Bible text you read in VerseUp, translated in 1611 and revised in 1769.
resources.copyright: Public domain. In the United Kingdom the King James Version is under a Crown patent held by Cambridge University Press, Oxford University Press and Collins.
resources.attribution: King James Version (1769). Public domain. Source: eBible.org.
resources.modifications: We added paragraph breaks to make it easier to read. The words are unchanged.

resources.name: World English Bible paragraphs
resources.author: eBible.org
resources.description: Shows where paragraphs begin, so the King James text reads in natural sections. None of its words are used.
resources.attribution: Paragraph positions from the World English Bible (public domain), eBible.org.

resources.name: Strong's Hebrew Dictionary
resources.author: James Strong, LL.D., S.T.D. (1894). XML edition corrected by David Troidl and David Instone-Brewer, published by Open Scriptures
resources.description: James Strong's classic 1894 dictionary of every Hebrew word in the Old Testament.
resources.attribution: Strong's Hebrew Dictionary (1894), public domain. XML edition: Open Scriptures (github.com/openscriptures/strongs).
resources.modifications: We use only Strong's own definitions.

resources.name: Strong's Greek Dictionary
resources.author: James Strong, S.T.D., LL.D. (1890). XML edition by Ulrik Petersen, published by Open Scriptures
resources.description: James Strong's classic 1890 dictionary of every Greek word in the New Testament.
resources.attribution: Strong's Greek Dictionary (1890), public domain. XML edition 1.4 by Ulrik Petersen (ulrikp.org), via Open Scriptures.

resources.name: STEP Bible Hebrew dictionary
resources.author: STEP Bible (STEPBible.org), based on work at Tyndale House, Cambridge
resources.description: Short, clear meanings of Hebrew words, written by scholars at Tyndale House, Cambridge.
resources.copyright: Data created by www.STEPBible.org based on work at Tyndale House Cambridge.
resources.attribution: STEP Bible (www.STEPBible.org), based on work at Tyndale House, Cambridge. CC BY 4.0. Source: STEPBible.github.io/STEPBible-Data.
resources.modifications: We left out one column that needs separate permission.

resources.name: STEP Bible Greek dictionary
resources.author: STEP Bible (STEPBible.org), based on work at Tyndale House, Cambridge
resources.description: Meanings of Greek words, written by scholars at Tyndale House, Cambridge.
resources.copyright: Data created by www.STEPBible.org based on work at Tyndale House Cambridge.
resources.attribution: STEP Bible (www.STEPBible.org), based on work at Tyndale House, Cambridge. CC BY 4.0. Source: STEPBible.github.io/STEPBible-Data.

resources.name: STEP Bible Hebrew Old Testament
resources.author: STEP Bible (STEPBible.org), based on work at Tyndale House, Cambridge
resources.description: The Old Testament in its original Hebrew and Aramaic, word by word, with an English meaning for each word.
resources.modifications: Arranged to match the King James verse numbers.
resources.copyright: Data created by www.STEPBible.org based on work at Tyndale House Cambridge.
resources.attribution: STEP Bible (www.STEPBible.org), based on work at Tyndale House, Cambridge. CC BY 4.0. Source: STEPBible.github.io/STEPBible-Data.

resources.name: STEP Bible Greek New Testament
resources.author: STEP Bible (STEPBible.org), based on work at Tyndale House, Cambridge; English translation based on the Berean Study Bible
resources.description: The New Testament in its original Greek, word by word, with an English meaning for each word.
resources.modifications: We show the Greek text the King James translators used, and note where other editions differ.
resources.copyright: Data created by www.STEPBible.org based on work at Tyndale House Cambridge.
resources.attribution: STEP Bible (www.STEPBible.org), based on work at Tyndale House, Cambridge. CC BY 4.0. Source: STEPBible.github.io/STEPBible-Data.

resources.name: STEP Bible grammar guide
resources.author: STEP Bible (STEPBible.org), based on work at Tyndale House, Cambridge
resources.description: Explains the grammar of each Hebrew and Greek word in plain words.
resources.copyright: Data created by www.STEPBible.org based on work at Tyndale House Cambridge.
resources.attribution: STEP Bible (www.STEPBible.org), based on work at Tyndale House, Cambridge. CC BY 4.0. Source: STEPBible.github.io/STEPBible-Data.

resources.name: STEP Bible people and places
resources.author: STEP Bible (STEPBible.org), based on work at Tyndale House, Cambridge
resources.description: Every person and place named in the Bible, with their families and every verse they appear in.
resources.modifications: We include STEP's facts only, not its longer written descriptions.
resources.copyright: Data created by www.STEPBible.org based on work at Tyndale House Cambridge.
resources.attribution: STEP Bible (www.STEPBible.org), based on work at Tyndale House, Cambridge. CC BY 4.0. Source: STEPBible.github.io/STEPBible-Data.

resources.name: OpenBible.info cross-references
resources.author: OpenBible.info
resources.description: Links between related verses, ranked by how many readers agreed.
resources.attribution: Cross references from OpenBible.info (www.openbible.info/labs/cross-references), CC BY.
resources.modifications: We left out links that no readers agreed with.

resources.name: CrossWire word links
resources.author: CrossWire Bible Society. Old Testament Strong's numbers from The Bible Foundation; New Testament from the KJV2003 Project and Dr. Maurice Robinson's Textus Receptus data
resources.description: Connects each English word of the King James text to the Hebrew or Greek word it translates.
resources.copyright: Any copyright that might be obtained for this effort is held by CrossWire Bible Society © 2003-2023.
resources.licence: General public licence to use the text for any purpose (CrossWire)
resources.attribution: Strong's tagging of the KJV from the CrossWire Bible Society KJV module 3.1 (crosswire.org), with data from The Bible Foundation, the KJV2003 Project and Dr. Maurice Robinson.
resources.summary: Free to use for any purpose.
